name: Android YouTube Downloader
tagline: Save videos from YouTube and other sites to watch later
description:
Android YouTube Downloader lets you save videos from YouTube and other popular sites like Facebook, Twitter, Twitch, and TikTok directly to your phone. Just paste a link and download the video to watch later, even without an internet connection.

It's a handy tool for anyone who wants to keep a copy of a video instead of relying on a stream that might disappear.
